If we cannot collect your electronic payment, or if your check is returned unpaid, we will issue a draft against your account. If you do not have sufficient funds in your account, a service charge of $20 or the maximum allowed by law will be debited from your account. Please contact the local Sparklight office about other payment options if you prefer not to have your check used in this way.
